title: Amazon invests $50B in OpenAI

sources.quote: Amazon will also invest $50 billion in OpenAI, starting with an initial $15 billion investment and followed by another $35 billion in the coming months when certain conditions are met.
Subsequent to June 30, 2026, we invested the remaining $21.3 billion Commitment Amount in shares of Series C Preferred Stock of OpenAI.

explain: Amazon agreed to buy $50 billion of OpenAI preferred shares: $15 billion up front and $35 billion later, which it had fully paid by mid-2026. Alongside it, OpenAI expanded its spending on Amazon's AWS cloud, so part of the money circles back to Amazon.
